social:piasnews-social-2f376ae8626c2e6a:.zh: 他们向 George 和 Oscar 都提了问题，但 George 回答完后记者们已经转向下一个话题了，所以 Oscar 就一副无所谓的样子 🙄🤷🏻‍♂️

social:piasnews-social-07d89e03771f43a0:.source_text: Q: are you turning a corner with this car now? oscar: a little bit. the progress isn't linear. you always find things that work and that don't, we're still in that phase. we're making progress and we're not standing still, which is the most important. https://t.co/1wLwX65pT7
social:piasnews-social-07d89e03771f43a0:.zh: 问：你现在对这辆车算是找到感觉了吗？Oscar：有一点吧。进步不是线性的。你总会发现有些东西管用、有些不管用，我们还处在这个阶段。我们在进步，没有原地踏步，这是最重要的。

social:piasnews-social-9d7d57811c4f5c1b:.source_text: Q: andrea says he's throwing more engineering resources behind you. is it making a difference? oscar: we're doing everything we can to improve. it's been a very good team response in trying improve as quick as we can. i feel well supported. https://t.co/GfEn9FyRcy
social:piasnews-social-9d7d57811c4f5c1b:.zh: 问：Andrea 说他正在为你投入更多工程资源。这有带来改变吗？Oscar：我们在尽一切努力去提升。整个团队反应非常好，都在尽快改进。我感觉自己得到了很好的支持。

social:piasnews-social-ecf6350e41867f9f:.source_text: Q: what do you need from the car to drive more intuitively? oscar: for it to behave a bit differently 😅 things that worked for me previously don't work this year so it's about finding things that do. i'm making progress on that but it's not that simple. https://t.co/s9GNa9M3Qj
social:piasnews-social-ecf6350e41867f9f:.zh: 问：你需要赛车做出什么改变才能开得更直觉？Oscar：希望它的表现能有点不一样吧 😅 以前对我管用的东西今年不管用了，所以关键是要找到管用的。我在这方面有进步，但没那么简单。
